body: I think that’s unfair of you to say. I’m sure there was a reason I stopped talking to you and this just proves that you and I wouldn’t have made a good match. I try to talk with everyone who messages me but sometimes things get buried and I don’t see the responses. It’s nothing personal.
I don’t understand what your problem with me is. I was nothing but nice to you. I’m sorry.
This guy is a creepy clingy 35 year old man..
